claims.text: Vector databases store, retrieve, and manage high-dimensional vector representations intrinsic to LLM operations.
Integrating vector databases with LLMs addresses core LLM operational challenges to enhance functionalities.

evidence.description: VecDBs offer a means to store, retrieve, and manage the high-dimensional vector representations intrinsic to LLM operations.
VecDBs emerge as a solution to LLM challenges by enhancing LLM functionalities through integration.

methodologies.name: Literature Survey and System Analysis
methodologies.description: A comprehensive review delineating foundational principles and analyzing the integration of LLMs and Vector Databases.

limitations.text: LLMs incur prohibitive commercial application costs.

future_work.text: Optimizing the confluence of LLMs and VecDBs for advanced data handling and knowledge extraction capabilities.
